card_name: Air India SBI Signature Credit Card
fee_details:
- 1st year Fee: Rs.4,999 + Taxes
- 2nd year Onwards: Rs.4,999 + Taxes
joining_perks: Enjoy welcome gift of 20,000 reward points on paying the joining fee of the card.
reward_structure:
- Transfer to travel: 30 points = 100 Rs.
- Transfer for others: 100 points = 100 Rs.
- All categories: 7500 points = 500 Rs.
key_highlights:
- Enjoy welcome gift of 20,000 reward points on paying the joining fee of the card.
- Avail lost card liability cover of Rs.1 Lakh.
- Make the most of the balance transfer facility on EMI to save money while paying your dues.
- Get up to 4 Takes bonus reward points and have them delivered to your home.
- With the Priority Pass Program enjoy access to more than 600+ international airport lounges.
- Enjoy a reward of 5,000 points on spending your renewal fee after one year.

benefits_features.Travel Benefits:
With the Priority Pass Program enjoy complimentary access at more than 600+ Airport Luxury Lounges.
Make the most of the Vistara Lounge Program for 2 complimentary visits to domestic airport lounge per quarter.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits:
15% off on fuel surcharge will be waived for purchases worth between Rs.500 and Rs.4000 at all petrol pumps.
Enjoy a minimum waiver of Rs.250 per month with this card.
benefits_features.Bill Pay Benefits: Pay your telephone, electricity, insurance, and other utility bills with the Card's Bill Pay facility on the credit card.
benefits_features.EMI Benefits: Purchases with your credit card worth more than Rs.2,500 can be converted into EMIs within 30 days with Flexpay.
benefits_features.Railway Booking Benefits: Book your railway tickets with this credit card and get them delivered to your home.

how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points?: You can redeem your reward points through net banking, phone banking, or by contacting the SBI card customer care.
how_tos.Here are the steps which you need to fol:
- Log on to your SBI credit card net banking account.
- Click on the option of 'redeem rewards'.
- You will then see your total reward points shown on the side of the page.
- Choose your reward category.
- Add your reward city where you currently live.
- Add the quantity of your reward and then click on 'add to cart'.
- Agree to the terms and conditions and then click on the option of 'place order'.

reward_point_benefits:
- Get reward points for every spend of Rs.100.
- Avail up to 30 reward points for every Rs.100 spent on Air India tickets from the mobile app or website of Air India.
- You get 10 points on booking the Air India tickets for others.

fees_and_charges.Cash convenience charges:
- 2.5% of the transaction amount or Rs.250 per transaction (SBI and domestic ATM).
- 2.5% of the transaction amount or Rs.500 per transaction (International ATM).
fees_and_charges.Statement retrieval fee: Rs.100 per statement (more than 2 months old)
fees_and_charges.Late payment fee:
NIL if the total amount due is from Rs.0 to Rs.500
Rs.200 if the total amount due is greater than Rs.500 and up to Rs.1000
Rs.700 if the total amount due is greater than Rs.1000 and up to Rs.5000
Rs.1900 if the total amount due is greater than Rs.5000 and up to Rs.10,000
Rs.2,100 if the total amount due is greater than Rs.10,000 and up to Rs.25,000
Rs.2,500 if the total amount due is greater than Rs.25,000
fees_and_charges.Payment dishonour fee: 2% on the payment amount (minimum at Rs60)
fees_and_charges.Cheque payment fee: Rs.100(for cheque payments up to Rs.5000)

miscellaneous: The limit of this credit card is at the discretion of the State Bank of India. The bank decides the credit limit depending on a number of factors such as the credit score of the applicant, the credit history, and the repayment of past and ongoing debts.

faqs.1. Is the Air India SBI Signature Card s: Yes, being a chip and pin enabled card, it is a safe card that you can use without worrying about security. This feature of the card protects it from counterfeiting and skimming.
faqs.2. What are the railway charges/surcharg: For railway tickets bought through the IRCTC website, the surcharge is 2.5% of the transaction amount. For railway tickets bought through the Indian Railways website, it is 1.8% on the transaction amount + service charges.
faqs.3. Do I need to pay anything for my Prio: Yes, whenever you pay for any Priority Pass member invoice, your account will be charged up to Rs.672.
faqs.4. What is the interest-free credit peri: You can enjoy an interest-free credit period of 20 to 45 days. This period is provided to you once the full amount of the previous month's outstanding balance spent on your credit card is paid. Moreover, you need to clear the amount within the period to prevent paying more interest.
faqs.5. What options do I have for paying the: You get multiple ways to make the payments for paying the dues for your Air India SBI Signature Card. These convenient methods include NEFT, Auto debit facility, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking, Visa Pay, Net Banking, National Automated Clearing House, etc.
